subject: gk
question:
In June 2025, EPFO's revised his auto-settlement limit. This limit is now

Rs. ____ lakh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 5 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **EPFO (Employees' Provident Fund Organisation)** revised its auto-settlement limit in **June 2025** to **Rs. 5 lakh**, enhancing the scope of automated claim settlement processes for its members.
 
• The **auto-settlement mechanism** is a system introduced to provide faster and more efficient claim processing, ensuring timely disbursal of funds to beneficiaries without manual intervention.
 
• This decision aligns with the **EPFO’s goal** of leveraging technology to simplify the claims process and reduce delays for its members.
 
• The limit was raised from previous thresholds to **Rs. 5 lakh**, ensuring a larger number of claims are covered under the automatic system, benefiting employees and retirees.
 
• The enhancement of this limit is expected to significantly improve the **service delivery efficiency**, reduce the workload of the EPFO staff, and improve customer satisfaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **EPFO Overview:**

 
 
• The **Employees' Provident Fund Organisation** is a statutory body under the **Ministry of Labour and Employment**, Government of India, established in **1952**.
 
• EPFO manages the provident fund (PF), pension, and insurance schemes for employees in India.
 
• It ensures social security for employees by providing retirement benefits and financial aid during unemployment or emergencies.
 
 
 
• **What is Auto-Settlement?**
 
 
• The **auto-settlement process** in EPFO refers to the automated processing of claims, where eligible claims are settled without manual intervention.
 
• This mechanism is designed to minimize errors, reduce processing time, and provide better services to EPFO members.
 
• Claims such as **partial withdrawals**, pension benefits, and final settlement are processed through this system.
 
• With the revised limit of **Rs. 5 lakh**, more claims will be processed automatically, offering faster access to funds for employees.
 
 
 
• **Importance of EPFO’s Auto-Settlement Process:**
 
 
• It minimizes manual errors, ensuring accurate and timely disbursal of funds.
 
• Automated claims reduce the workload on EPFO staff, allowing them to focus on more complex issues and cases.
 
• It enhances the transparency and efficiency of the overall claims process.
 
• Beneficiaries can access their entitled funds quickly, especially during emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Other Measures by EPFO:**
 
 
• EPFO has been actively working on digitizing its services, offering facilities like **online claim submissions**, **e-nomination**, and **UMANG App** for members to access services seamlessly.
 
• It also provides services like **passbook access**, **UAN activation**, and grievance redressal through online platforms.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Eligibility for EPFO Membership:**

 
 
• All organizations with **20 or more employees** are required to register with EPFO.
 
• Employees drawing a monthly salary of **up to Rs. 15,000** are eligible for mandatory EPF contributions.
 
 
 
• **EPFO Schemes:**
 
 
• **Employees' Provident Fund Scheme (EPFS), 1952:** Provides retirement benefits to employees.
 
• **Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance Scheme (EDLI), 1976:** Provides life insurance benefits to employees.
 
• **Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS), 1995:** Provides pension to employees after retirement.
 
 
 
• **EPFO Initiatives:**
 
 
• Introduction of **UMANG App** for accessing EPFO services online.
 
• Implementation of a **Universal Account Number (UAN)** for portability and ease of access.
 
• Digitalization of services to enhance **transparency** and **efficiency**.
 
• Regularly increasing the auto-settlement limits to improve service delivery and reduce delays.
